result.title: SkillScaffold: Scaffolding Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Policy-Adaptive Skill Credit Assignment and Selective Injection
result.summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models (LLMs) to learn from multi-turn interactions with verifiable outcomes. Textual skills can improve exploration by distilling prior interactions into reusable guidance. However, existing skill-based RL approaches often either assume skill injection is beneficial or rely on indirect feedback or rollout-intensive evaluation to assess its utility. Our pilot studies show that rollout-based utility estimation for skill credit assignment is costly and unstable under limited sampling, while skill benefits vary across candidates and depend on the current policy's competence on each query. To address these challenges, we introduce SkillScaffold, a policy-adaptive training scaffold that combines low-cost skill-utility estimation with selective skill injection. By reusing outcome-verified training trajectories, SkillScaffold generates candidate skills and estimates their utility through outcome-aware likelihood comparisons, without candidate-specific environment rollouts. The resulting utility guides whether and which skill to inject, retaining skill-free execution when no candidate is estimated to help. Joint training enables the Generator to produce skills tailored to the evolving Executor. Scaffolded RL encourages skill internalization for skill-free inference. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, ScienceWorld, and $τ^2$-Bench demonstrate gains over strong agentic-RL and skill-based RL baselines across both short- and long-horizon tasks. Ablations and further analyses support the importance of utility-based selection and abstention. Our code is available at https://github.com/Vaidurya00/SkillScaffold.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SkillScaffold：一种策略自适应的 agentic RL 训练脚手架，复用已验证的交互轨迹低成本估计候选技能的效用，据此决定是否注入、注入哪个文本技能，并在无候选有用时保留无技能执行；同时联合训练技能生成器与执行器，推动技能内化到无技能推理。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「效用驱动的选择性注入与弃用」与 LVR 中是否触发额外计算（THINK/LOOK/STOP）及 latent 内容的贡献分配相近，技能内化到无技能推理也可能为「训练时使用 latent、推理时去除」提供可供核查的线索；但论文面向纯文本 agent、无视觉状态，仅属方法层面借鉴。
